description: Annotate a video with timed boxes, text labels, and arrows. Fallback fonts used are listed in fallbackFonts; characters no font covers are reported in warnings.

fontFile.description: Font: a .ttf/.otf/.ttc path or a C:\Windows\Fonts file name. Default: bundled Inter, with a covering system font for scripts it lacks (CJK, emoji, Arabic, ...).

items.description: Boxes, text labels, and arrows, drawn in order (later on top), in video pixels. Each shows from..to seconds (default: whole video); color is a name, #RRGGBB, or name@alpha.

background.description: Dark panel behind the text (default true).

x2.description: Head (x2,y2) is the point the arrow points at.

output.description: Optional output path. Defaults under SCREENCAST_HOME/edits.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file at the output path (default false).

name: callout
title: Add Callouts
